warn_msg_otp: They asked for your OTP. Banks and police never do this.
warn_msg_money: They asked you to send money. Banks and police never do this.
warn_msg_official: They say they are from the police, a bank or the government. Real officers never ask for money or codes on the phone.
warn_msg_rush: They are rushing you to act now. Real organisations give you time to check.
warn_msg_general: This call sounds like a scam.
warn_msg_several: This call has several signs of a scam.
warn_msg_earlier: This call had signs of a scam earlier on.
warn_do_details: Do not give any personal details.
warn_spoken: This may be a scam. {0} Hang up now.
a11y_ends_call_first: Ends this call first, then opens your phone app. You tap Call.
a11y_opens_messages: Opens your messages with a note ready. You tap Send.
sms_family: ScamGuard: I may be on a scam call. Please call me.
no_phone_app: This phone can't make calls or send messages.
careful_msg_money: They talked about money or codes. Don't share them.
careful_msg_official: They say they are an official. Check by calling the official number yourself.
careful_msg_rush: They are rushing you. Take your time.
careful_msg_general: Something in this call sounds unusual. Don't share personal details.
error_banner: Could not check this call. This does not mean it is safe.
set_show_careful_line: Off: only scam warnings show. Every call is still saved.
a11y_discard_hint: Ends the call without a summary. Nothing is saved.
